text: {"assertions":["An infinite recursion bug was discovered in graph/traversal/walker.rs on 2026-01-19 that affected records with non-ASCII names.","The infinite recursion could be reproduced by walking the cyclic fixture graph, causing the stack to grow until a guard condition was triggered.","The root cause was two database writes that were never wrapped in a transaction.","The fix involved wrapping both writes in a single transaction, implemented in PR #9151 on branch fix/infinite-recursion-1.","After applying the fix, a graph traversal job that previously took 2 hours completed in 24 minutes.","The graph engine code is written in Rust and the fix is covered by the module test block in graph/traversal/walker.rs."]}
